glosses: Lámina en donde se imprime algún mensaje, ya sea con palabras, símbolos o imágenes, y se deja a la vista para difundir información.
Escrito anónimo que se fija sobre un cartel y se deja en un lugar público con mensajes satíricos hacia algún político.
Escrito que se fija sobre un cartel en un lugar público, en donde se invita a otra persona a una contienda.
Escrito que se fija sobre un cartel en un lugar público, en donde se extorsiona al enemigo en una negociación, por ejemplo, en lo que respecta a la liberación de prisioneros.

glosses: To direct (somebody) to services, resources, etc.

examples.text: We believe that some Carers' Centres already offer an effective 'first stop shop' for signposting carers to local organisations, services and benefits, and for providing ongoing support as carers' circumstances change.

glosses: To indicate logical progress of a discourse using words or phrases such as now, right, to recap, to sum up, as I was saying, etc.

examples.text: Bede, never one to shrink from a challenge, focused his energies not only onto calculating Easter but also onto describing why the maths mattered as much as the result. In this, his elevated rhetoric is balanced by a very human enthusiasm — it's hard not to love a writer who signposts his core hypotheses with phrases such as 'now to gut the bowels of this question!'
